comments: 72295d78: This section of code is dedicated to managing IRT (Incident Report Tracking) records, including editing, listing, and initializing various components.
3d7bec21: If the first piece of DGJTEDT equals 1, proceed with editing the record.
dce4d0d0: Create a new record by calling the DATA^DGJTEE3 routine.
68381e3e: Exit the subroutine.
95cca886: Reset the VALMBCK variable to its default state.
26fb322b: Check if the report type is one of OP REPORT, DISCHARGE SUMMARY, or INTERIM SUMMARY, then re-initialize and set VALMBCK to 'R'.
0498b248: For other report types, call INIT4 subroutine for processing.
2e375577: Set VALMBCK to 'R' indicating a screen refresh is required, then exit the EDIT subroutine.
5b37e129: This code block is responsible for setting up space and width parameters for various fields such as record type, deficiency, physician, status, category, and event date.
a2afab75: Set up spacing and width for the record type if DGJTREC is defined.
06b0d768: For a deficiency record, set its spacing and width if DGJTREC is not defined.
fb19d3ea: Define spacing and width for the physician field.
ca5b1103: Set spacing and width for the status field.
80ee7b1b: Assign spacing and width for the category field.
ee232200: Determine spacing and width for the event date field.
725e2f04: Get the internal entry number for the 'COMPLETED' status.
3efba034: Get the internal entry number for the 'REVIEWED' status.
428cf702: Retrieve the internal entry number for 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' status.
dbd2f5c3: Exit the INCSP subroutine.
52324956: Initialize variables for listing admissions and set counters to zero.
ab4246bc: Loop through admissions, checking for user interruption or completion.
994ab18c: If DGJTCH1 flag is set, indicate selection completion and clear the flag for next use.
8484cb1c: Clear the temporary flags for change detection.
81e6c031: Prompt the user for an admission selection if not the end of the list.
6269de82: Prompt message for choosing an admission starting from 1.
0b19fb9f: Display the range of admissions available for selection or option to quit.
c88a1373: Read the user's selection with a timeout.
e1a1b0b1: If the user's selection is invalid, prompt again.
e4cd72fa: Display the selected admission number.
ac1b1972: Set the internal IEN for the selected admission.
d149e346: Exit the LIST subroutine.
5df38a88: Call DT1 subroutine in DGJTEE3 for processing.
6effd6d4: Display admission details including date and type, shortening the display if necessary.
e4fd8a2c: Show discharge date if available; otherwise, indicate 'N/A'.
2f1b289b: Prompt user for action every five records.
af3ef394: Exit the DT1 subroutine.
0e7af32a: Formatted display of dates for selection.
d4a3be29: Exit the DT subroutine.
ded71df7: Prompt the user to quit or return to display more entries.
c2c72b1e: Capture the user's selection or quit command, setting flags appropriately.
15822278: Exit the CHOZ subroutine.
3db51bba: This block sets up global arrays for managing IRT record display in a list manager format.
add2e39d: Declare local variables for counting.
1f80c0c4: Initialize the count variables to zero.
e019fa79: Prepare a new entry in the temporary global storage for a report.
5c4be24c: Set up list manager index and content placeholder.
c170e957: Map the list manager index to the internal record number.
062c1052: Exit the SETG subroutine.
c4cdc1b7: If deleting a record, switch to the 'DGJ DELETE RECORD' list manager template.
0fb46d28: If not deleting, switch to the 'DGJ IRT REC EDIT' template for editing.
a2471d33: Exit the INIT subroutine.
a33e7782: Switch to the 'DGJ IRT REC ENTER' template for entering a new record.
4ef30e7d: Exit the INIT1 subroutine.
782b2929: Switch to the 'DGJ EXP ENTRY' template for expedited entry.
ad280bc8: Exit the INIT3 subroutine.
8e37142f: This block handles the initialization for editing deficiency records.
735956e7: If deleting a deficiency, switch to the 'DGJ DELETE DEFICIENCY' template.
5c991ddf: Switch to the 'DGJ DEF EDIT' template for deficiency record editing.
8d63c8e6: Exit the INIT4 subroutine.
073bbd49: This section handles the quick completion of reports through selection.
62fe1047: Declare variables for managing the quick completion process.
9f0d664d: Reset the VALMBCK variable.
b413e263: Select records for processing and return to report if none selected.
767e6b83: Prepare the screen for full display and set VALMBCK to 'R'.
d1a3f604: For each selected record, set its status to completed if applicable.
7d03c160: Exit the quick completion process and return to the main entry point.
5a9d4bae: Skip processing if the record type is not applicable.
025e5fd7: Set the record status to 'COMPLETED' and clean up.
13182665: Exit the SET subroutine.
3287a59d: Return to the main report entry point.
9eeeab1e: Clean up and remove temporary variables and globals used in processing.
9731dfa4: Further cleanup of temporary variables and settings.
55fd2077: Final clean up and exit the QUIT subroutine.
